definitions.explanation: Refers to the speaker or the subject of the sentence.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦みて→みる：00283_miru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{自分|じぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}した→掃除：02889_souji⟧。
{自分|じぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自分|じぶん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I do my own things myself.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{自分|じぶん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お→お：03097_o⟧⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持|も}っていった→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧。
examples.english: I made a boxed lunch myself and took it to school.

notes:
{自分|じぶん} is a reflexive pronoun meaning "oneself." Unlike English, it is not limited to the speaker — it refers back to the subject of the sentence, whoever that may be.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {自分|じぶん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: by oneself (emphasizes doing it independently)
- {自分|じぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: one's own ({自分|じぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧ = one's own room)
- {自分|じぶん}⟦{自身|じしん}→自身：30345_jishin⟧: oneself (emphatic)
- {自分|じぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自分|じぶん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do one's own things by oneself

FLEXIBLE REFERENCE:
{自分|じぶん} refers to whoever is the subject:
- ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自分|じぶん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (I made it myself)
- ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自分|じぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}づいた→気づく：01933_kizuku⟧ (He noticed his own mistake)

AS FIRST-PERSON PRONOUN:
In casual male speech (especially military, sports contexts), {自分|じぶん} is sometimes used to mean "I/me" directly: {自分|じぶん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦そう→そう：01167_sou⟧⟦{思|おも}います→思う：00492_omou⟧ (I think so).
